map.绝缘电阻随温度升高而下降，故统一修正到 20℃ 比较；导体电阻以标准截面值 ×1: Insulation resistance falls as temperature rises, so all values are corrected to 20 °C for comparison; conductor resistance is capped at the standard cross-section value × 1.1. All three of insulation resistance, conductor resistance, and withstand voltage must pass before the installation test counts as qualified.
